title: Design System Architecture
summary: A design system connects principles, tokens, components, patterns, documentation and governance into one evolvable product.

MUST.text: Separate foundations (tokens), components and task-level patterns into distinct layers with documented boundaries.
Define ownership, contribution, review, release and deprecation paths before publishing components.

SHOULD.text: Version the system with semver and publish migration notes for breaking changes.

AVOID.text: Do not treat a component catalogue without usage guidance as a complete system.
Do not let application teams fork components without a contribution path.

DECIDE.decision: Keep for one release cycle with warning

EXAMPLE.good: "Date picker is a component; invoice creation flow is a pattern composing it."
EXAMPLE.bad: "A Figma component library with no code, docs or owner called a design system."

FAILURE_MODES: A polished screen can still fail the task; validate against the defined user outcome.
Systems without ownership decay into inconsistent forks.
Treating a catalogue as complete skips usage and accessibility guidance.
